title: Create a @taucad/* workspace project
description: Scaffolds a policy-routed @taucad/* project with placement-owned tags, build mode, tests, and Tau conventions.

name.x-prompt: What is the package name (without @taucad/ prefix)?

description.description: Package description for package.json and README

scope.description: Placement, which derives tags, privacy, and build defaults (packages for publishable surfaces, libs for shared capabilities, apps/libs for private application capabilities, tools for private dev-time-only tooling)

scopeTag.description: Audience tag; packages, libs, and tools require shared, while apps/libs supports shared or ui

layer.description: Required architecture layer for apps/libs projects

react.description: Configure React peers, JSX, jsdom, and Testing Library for an apps/libs project

build.description: Placement-owned build mode: false for apps/libs and true for packages, libs, and tools; a supplied value must match
